required.context: Error message when email is empty

invalid.string: Please enter a valid email address
invalid.context: Error message when email format is invalid

min.string: Password must be at least 8 characters
min.context: Error message when password is too short

max.context: Error message when password is too long

title.context: Link to register a new user

description.context: Description to register a new user

loading.context: Button text when login is in progress

next.context: Button to go to next step

change_email.context: Accessible label for returning to the email step to change the address

generic.string: An error occurred. Please try again.
generic.context: Generic error message for login failures

unknown_provider.context: Error when authentication provider is not recognized

invalid_credentials.context: Error message when login credentials are invalid

route_not_found.string: Login route not found. Please contact your administrator.
route_not_found.context: Error when the login API route returns 404

system_timeout.string: Unable to reach the server. The connection may be busy — please try again.
system_timeout.context: Error when system configuration request times out

session_expired.string: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
session_expired.context: Shown on the login form after the API returns 401

sso_failed.string: Single sign-on failed (error {code}). Please try again.
sso_failed.context: Shown on the SSO landing page when the API redirects back with an error code

sso_provider_unreachable.string: The sign-in server is unreachable. Please try again.
sso_provider_unreachable.context: SSO error S000210 when the OpenID provider cannot be reached

sso_exchange_failed.string: Single sign-on failed. Please try again.
sso_exchange_failed.context: SSO error S000211 when the authorization code exchange fails

sso_user_not_found.string: No account matches this sign-in. Contact your administrator.
sso_user_not_found.context: SSO error S000212 when the user is missing from the user sources

sso_state_invalid.string: The sign-in session expired. Please try again.
sso_state_invalid.context: SSO error S000213 when the state is missing, expired, or already used

sso_state_storage.string: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
sso_state_storage.context: SSO error S000214 when the state cache is unreachable

sso_redirect_not_allowed.string: This sign-in return address is not allowed. Contact your administrator.
sso_redirect_not_allowed.context: SSO error S000215 when the UI origin is missing from the allowed redirect list

sso_back_to_login.context: Button on the SSO landing page after a failed single sign-on

system_retry.context: Button to retry loading system configuration
